hero.name: Lapu-Lapu
hero.title: Chieftain of Mactan
hero.effect: Beachhead Decimation: Deals double damage when attacking non-Hero units with higher DEF than ATK.
hero.lore: The proud datu of Mactan who stood against foreign invasion, felling Magellan on the shores of his homeland with unmatched martial strength.

hero.name: Andres Bonifacio
hero.title: Father of the Katipunan
hero.effect: Cry of Revolution (Sacrifice): Sacrifice 2 allied cards to double his ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Supreme leader of the Katipunan whose furious battle cry broke centuries of colonial rule through raw, unyielding resolve.

hero.name: Jose Rizal
hero.title: The Enlightened Polymath
hero.effect: Awakened Will: Upon defeat, return 1 non-Hero unit from your Graveyard to your Hand.
hero.lore: Armed with a pen sharper than any sword, his revolutionary writings awakened the national consciousness of a captive people.

hero.name: Gabriela Silang
hero.title: Joan of Arc of Ilocos
hero.effect: Last Stand (Sacrifice): Sacrifice 2 allied cards to double her ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Taking command after her husband's murder, she charged fearlessly on horseback as the fiery general of the Ilocano resistance.

hero.name: Sultan Kudarat
hero.title: Lord of Mindanao
hero.effect: Citadel Defense: Immune to Poison, Sleep, and Paralysed status effects.
hero.lore: The formidable Sultan of Mindanao who united rival clans and repelled foreign conquest across the south for over five decades.

hero.name: Apolinario Mabini
hero.title: The Sublime Paralytic
hero.effect: Mind Over Body: Permanently afflicted with Paralysed (cannot attack). Increases all allied cards' DEF by +5 while active on the field.
hero.lore: The sublime mind behind the Philippine Republic whose intellect and legal strategy guided the revolution despite his paralysis.

hero.name: Emilio Aguinaldo
hero.title: First President of the Republic
hero.effect: Commanding Order: Once per turn, select 1 allied unit; it recovers from Sleep or Paralysed immediately.
hero.lore: First president of the Philippine Republic who led army forces through complex campaigns across Luzon.

hero.name: Antonio Luna
hero.title: The Fiery Tactician
hero.effect: Ruthless Counter: Inflicts Paralysed for 1 turn on any enemy unit that damages him.
hero.lore: A fiery military genius who forged raw revolutionary recruits into a disciplined force through strict tactics and fearless leadership.

hero.name: Melchora Aquino
hero.title: Tandang Sora / Mother of Balintawak
hero.effect: Battlefield Care: At the start of your turn, revive 1 dead card from your Graveyard to your Hand.
hero.lore: Mother of the Revolution who turned her home into a secret sanctuary and field hospital for wounded Katipuneros.

hero.name: Gregoria de Jesus
hero.title: Lakambini of the Katipunan
hero.effect: Keeper of Secrets: Prevents enemy status effects (Poison, Sleep, Paralysed) from affecting adjacent allied units.
hero.lore: The Lakambini of the Katipunan who risked her life guarding secret revolutionary documents, seals, and armaments.

hero.name: Diego Silang
hero.title: Ilocano Rebel Leader
hero.effect: Martial Vengeance: If defeated, doubles the ATK of Gabriela Silang if she is on the field or in your Hand.
hero.lore: A charismatic visionary who established an autonomous Ilocano state before being struck down by assassins.

hero.name: Marcelo H. del Pilar
hero.title: The Great Propagandist
hero.effect: Deceptive Propaganda: Inflicts Sleep on 1 target enemy non-Hero unit for 2 turns.
hero.lore: Master propagandist and editor of La Solidaridad who waged a relentless literary war against colonial abuse.

hero.name: Juan Luna
hero.title: Master of the Canvas
hero.effect: Spoliarium Strike: Instantly sends 1 non-Hero enemy card with 5 DEF or lower to the Graveyard.
hero.lore: Master painter whose striking canvases captured the suffering and fiery spirit of the Filipino struggle.

hero.name: Padre Mariano Gomez
hero.title: Martyr Priest of Cavite
hero.effect: Solemn Sacrifice: When sent to the Graveyard, revive 1 non-Hero card from your Graveyard to your Hand.
hero.lore: Eldest of the martyred priests whose unjust execution galvanized the entire archipelago toward national identity.

hero.name: Padre Jose Burgos
hero.title: Reformist Cleric
hero.effect: Voice of Reform: Removes Paralysed and Sleep status from all allied cards upon deployment.
hero.lore: An outspoken advocate for native clergy whose reformist writings made him a prime target of colonial authorities.

hero.name: Padre Jacinto Zamora
hero.title: Patriot Priest
hero.effect: Silent Resolve: When defeated, inflicts Paralysed on the attacker for 2 turns.
hero.lore: A dedicated defender of indigenous rights whose martyrdom transformed him into an enduring symbol of resistance.

hero.name: Teresa Magbanua
hero.title: Joan of Arc of the Visayas
hero.effect: Vanguard Rush: Can launch an attack immediately on the turn she is deployed.
hero.lore: The Joan of Arc of the Visayas, an expert markswoman and cavalry officer who won successive battles against invaders.

hero.name: Trinidad Tecson
hero.title: Mother of Biak-na-Bato
hero.effect: Trench Medic: Restores 5 DEF to 1 damaged allied card at the end of each turn.
hero.lore: Mother of Biak-na-Bato who fought in blood-soaked trenches and organized field medical care for wounded rebels.

hero.name: Francisco Dagohoy
hero.title: Leader of the Longest Revolt
hero.effect: Indomitable Rebellion: Immune to Paralysed and gains +1 DEF for every turn he remains on the field.
hero.lore: Leader of the longest rebellion in Philippine history, holding the mountain strongholds of Bohol for 85 years.

hero.name: Macario Sakay
hero.title: The Last Katipunero General
hero.effect: Mountain Guerrilla: Cannot be targeted by enemy card effects or skills during the first turn he enters play.
hero.lore: The last Katipunero general who maintained guerrilla resistance in the mountains of Southern Luzon long after others fell.

hero.name: Artemio Ricarte
hero.title: The Uncompromising General
hero.effect: Unbroken Spirit: Immune to Sleep and cannot be forced to return to the Hand by enemy card effects.
hero.lore: A fierce Katipunan general who refused ever taking an oath of allegiance to foreign occupiers, enduring decades in exile.

hero.name: Miguel Malvar
hero.title: The Last Surrendering General
hero.effect: Enduring Resistance (Sacrifice): Sacrifice 2 allied cards to double his ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: The steadfast general who assumed command of revolutionary forces, holding out as the final main general to surrender.

hero.name: Vicente Lukban
hero.title: Master of Samar Guerrillas
hero.effect: Ambush Trap: Inflicts Poison (3 damage per turn for 2 turns) on any enemy card that attacks him.
hero.lore: Master of mountain guerrilla tactics who engineered the famous resistance victory in Samar.

hero.name: Gregorio del Pilar
hero.title: Hero of Tirad Pass
hero.effect: Narrow Pass Stand: Intercepts and absorbs all direct attacks targeted at adjacent allied cards.
hero.lore: The boy general who made a heroic final stand at Tirad Pass to secure the retreat of his commander-in-chief.

hero.name: Panday Pira
hero.title: First Cannon-maker
hero.effect: Artillery Forge: Grants +3 ATK to adjacent allied non-Hero units every turn.
hero.lore: Master blacksmith of Pampanga who forged heavy artillery and brass cannons for defenders across Luzon.

hero.name: Jose Abad Santos
hero.title: Martyr of Judicial Integrity
hero.effect: Unshakeable Oath: While on the field, your other units are immune to Poison and Sleep.
hero.lore: Chief Justice who chose execution over collaborating with wartime occupiers, embodying legal integrity.

hero.name: Vicente Lim
hero.title: The West Point Tactician
hero.effect: Tactical Fortification: All adjacent cards receive +3 DEF.
hero.lore: The first West Point graduate of the Philippines who organized tenacious defensive lines during WWII.

hero.name: Josefa Llanes Escoda
hero.title: Heroine of the Resistance
hero.effect: Underground Supply: Revives 1 dead non-Hero unit from your Graveyard to your Hand once every 3 turns.
hero.lore: Heroine of the underground resistance who smuggled food, medicine, and critical supplies to prisoners of war.

hero.name: Wenceslao Vinzons
hero.title: Bicol Guerrilla Leader
hero.effect: Guerrilla Raid: Inflicts Paralysed on 1 enemy card for 1 turn upon entering the field.
hero.lore: Youth leader who organized one of the earliest guerrilla units in Bicol, harassing enemy forces from mountain hideouts.

hero.name: Tomas Claudio
hero.title: World War I Hero
hero.effect: Vanguard Charge: Sacrifices 5 DEF to gain +5 ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: The first Filipino soldier to sacrifice his life on European battlefields during World War I.

hero.name: Rajah Sulayman
hero.title: Defender of Maynila
hero.effect: Scorched Earth: Deals 3 flat damage to all non-Hero enemy units on the field when played.
hero.lore: Ruler of Maynila who chose to burn his own kingdom to the ground rather than submit to foreign domination.

hero.name: Lakandula
hero.title: Paramount Ruler of Tondo
hero.effect: Alliance Shield: Increases the DEF of all allied non-Hero units by +2.
hero.lore: Paramount ruler of Tondo who mobilized regional alliances to defend his people's ancestral rights.

hero.name: Rajah Humabon
hero.title: Chieftain of Cebu
hero.effect: Diplomatic Pact: Renders 1 selected enemy card unable to attack for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Pre-colonial chieftain of Cebu who forged early diplomatic pacts to secure his island realm.

hero.name: Princess Urduja
hero.title: Amazon Warrior Queen
hero.effect: Trial of Combat: Disables all active skills and effects of the target enemy card during battle.
hero.lore: Warrior queen of Pangasinan who commanded an elite corps of female fighters and defeated all challengers in single combat.

hero.name: Dagami
hero.title: Chieftain of Leyte
hero.effect: Fierce Retaliation: Counterattacks with full ATK whenever damaged by a physical strike.
hero.lore: Chieftain of Leyte who led an early armed resistance against foreign tax collectors and garrisons.

hero.name: Tamblot
hero.title: Babaylan of Bohol
hero.effect: Ancestral Curse: Inflicts Poison (4 damage per turn for 2 turns) on 1 target enemy unit.
hero.lore: Native babaylan who rallied the people of Bohol to break free from colonial religious dominance.

hero.name: Bankaw
hero.title: Chieftain of Limasawa
hero.effect: Spiritual Chant: Inflicts Sleep on 1 enemy card for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Aged chieftain of Limasawa who led an uprising to protect traditional ancestral spiritual beliefs.

hero.name: Francisco Maniago
hero.title: Leader of the Pampanga Revolt
hero.effect: River Blockade: Inflicts Paralysed on up to 2 enemy non-Hero units for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Leader of the Pampanga revolt who shut down river transport networks to force fair treatment for his people.

hero.name: Almazan
hero.title: King of the Ilocos Revolt
hero.effect: Crown Strike (Sacrifice): Sacrifice 2 allied cards to double his ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Crowned king of the Ilocos revolt who led mountain warriors against fortified colonial outposts.

hero.name: Hermano Pule
hero.title: Founder of Cofradía de San José
hero.effect: Brotherhood Sanctuary: Revives 1 dead non-Hero card from your Graveyard to your Hand upon entering play.
hero.lore: Religious reformer who founded a brotherhood in Tayabas and led thousands in armed defense of spiritual freedom.

hero.name: Papa Isio
hero.title: Negros Mountain Rebel
hero.effect: Mountain Stronghold: Increases his own DEF by +4 when his HP drops below half.
hero.lore: Millenarian leader who held out in the mountains of Negros, battling both Spanish and American forces.

hero.name: Simeon Ola
hero.title: Bicol Guerrilla Commander
hero.effect: Relentless Ambush: Deals 5 direct damage to an enemy card and inflicts Paralysed for 1 turn.
hero.lore: Daring general who staged guerrilla ambushes throughout Bicol, standing as one of the last commanders to lay down arms.

hero.name: Leon Kilat
hero.title: Legendary Cebuano Commander
hero.effect: Lightning Strike: Bypasses defending front-line cards to directly attack enemy back-line support units.
hero.lore: Legendary revolutionary leader in Cebu whose martial speed and mystical reputation struck fear into opposing lines.

hero.name: Roman Basa
hero.title: Second Katipunan President
hero.effect: Secret Courier: Draws 1 extra card from your deck when a card is revived from the Graveyard.
hero.lore: Second President of the Katipunan who organized secret smuggling channels for revolutionary literature.

hero.name: Ladislao Diwa
hero.title: Co-founder of the Katipunan
hero.effect: Recruitment Call: Revives 1 low-tier non-Hero card from your Graveyard to your Hand.
hero.lore: One of the three founding members of the Katipunan who personally recruited early revolutionary cells in Cavite.

hero.name: Teodoro Plata
hero.title: Katipunan Pioneer
hero.effect: Logistics Supply: Increases the ATK of all allied non-Hero units by +2.
hero.lore: Co-founder of the secret society who managed internal logistics and arms procurement during the revolution birth.

hero.name: Marina Dizon
hero.title: Katipunan Women's Wing Leader
hero.effect: Guard Duty: Negates the first attack made against this card each round.
hero.lore: Fearless officer of the Katipunan women's wing who initiated new members and kept secret financial records.

hero.name: Agueda Kahabagan
hero.title: The Tagalog Joan of Arc
hero.effect: Fearless Charge (Sacrifice): Sacrifice 2 allied cards to double her ATK for 1 turn.
hero.lore: The only official female general of the Philippine Army, famed for charging into combat dressed in white while wielding a rifle and bolos.

hero.name: Gen. Licerio Gerónimo
hero.title: Commander of the Tiradores
hero.effect: Deadly Marksmanship: Inflicts Vampiric Bleed (3 damage per turn for 3 turns) on target enemy card while healing Gerónimo.
hero.lore: Commander of the famous Tiradores de la Muerte (Sharpshooters of Death) who led troops at the Battle of San Mateo.

hero.name: Geronima Pecson
hero.title: Pioneer Educator & Humanitarian
hero.effect: Humanitarian Grace: Cleanses all status conditions (Poison, Sleep, Paralysed, Bleed) from all allied units upon deployment.
hero.lore: Pioneer educator and humanitarian who fortified the nation cultural and educational foundation through civil service.

hero.name: Raven Cruz
hero.title: The Argos — Hari sa Propesiya
hero.effect: Paningin ng Tadhana: Deals 10 direct damage and ignores 5 DEF. Passive (Hari sa Propesiya): Once per battle, endures fatal damage and remains at 1 HP.
hero.lore: Raven was an ordinary youth until the awakening of the mysterious Eye of Argos. Connected to a power older than the six divine blessings, he stands above gods and guardians. His burden is not merely defeating Kalibata, but maintaining his humanity.

hero.name: Aquila
hero.title: The Luna — Keeper of the Argos
hero.effect: Halik ng Buwan: Restores 8 HP and gives +5 DEF to an ally until next turn. Passive: Gains +3 ATK and +3 DEF while Raven is on the battlefield.
hero.lore: Destined counterpart to Raven Cruz, representing the celestial balance that keeps destiny from consuming the Argos. When Raven's power burns too bright, Aquila's lunar radiance brings him back.

hero.name: Aldrin Del Rosario
hero.title: Fire Guardian (Blessed by Gugurang)
hero.effect: Panganoron: Hukom ng Apoy: Deals +8 damage to an enemy; deals +10 damage instead if target is already injured.
hero.lore: Wielding the Sibat ni Panganoron, Aldrin channels the sacred flames born in the heart of ancient volcanoes. The hotter his willpower and courage burn, the more devastating his divine spear becomes.

hero.name: Ace Garcia
hero.title: Wind Guardian (Blessed by Sibol)
hero.effect: Bagyong Walang Hanggan: Deals 7 damage and reduces target DEF by 5 for the next turn.
hero.lore: Dominion over Habagat and Amihan allows Ace to move at impossible velocities. To his adversaries, there are hundreds of phantom duplicates slicing through the sky with twin divine ringblades.

hero.name: Daniel Madrigal
hero.title: Earth Guardian (Blessed by Taliyak)
hero.effect: Puso ng Lupa: Drives fist into earth dealing 6 damage and grants himself +8 DEF until next turn.
hero.lore: Known as "Ang Pader na Hindi Guguho". Encased within the living Baluti ni Carpio connected directly to the bedrock of the islands, Daniel does not need a weapon; he is an impenetrable living bastion.

hero.name: Jessie Danao
hero.title: Water Guardian (Blessed by Amanikable)
hero.effect: Galit ng Karagatan: Deals 8 damage with tidal serpent strike and heals himself for 4 HP.
hero.lore: Commander of the two mystic oceanic orbs: Alon, the soothing rain of revival, and Daluyong, the catastrophic tidal serpent. He is the quiet sea before the tempest.

hero.name: Alice Belmonte
hero.title: Light Guardian (Blessed by Mayari)
hero.effect: Liwanag ng Kabilugan: Deals 6 radiant damage to an enemy and restores 5 HP to an allied unit.
hero.lore: Bearer of Sinag, the Moon Staff. Her sacred light does not burn—it illuminates hidden pathways and purges despair from allied warriors, guiding the Argos when night falls.

hero.name: Derrick Bautista
hero.title: Dark Guardian (Blessed by Sakulag)
hero.effect: Pangil ng Pitong Lason: Deals 7 damage and inflicts Poison (loses 2 HP each turn for 2 turns).
hero.lore: The assassin whom even other guardians dread. Armed with the Pangil ng Pitong Lason, Derrick strikes from absolute shadow, targeting body, mind, and spirit with supernatural venom.

hero.name: Bernardo Carpio
hero.title: Titan of the Two Mountains
hero.effect: Seismic Rupture: Deals 8 damage and permanently destroys the target tile land bonuses.
hero.lore: The mythological titan trapped between two colossal clashing mountains, whose struggle causes earthquakes across the archipelago.

hero.name: Lam-ang
hero.title: Immortal Warrior of Nalbuan
hero.effect: Golden Rooster Crow: Revives with full HP once per battle upon defeat.
hero.lore: Born with the gift of immediate speech and superhuman vigor, he traversed treacherous mountain ranges and slew legions of beasts.

hero.name: Prinsipe Bantugan
hero.title: Champion of Bumbaran
hero.effect: Darangen Tempest: Attacks all adjacent enemy units simultaneously with his flying kris.
hero.lore: The invincible hero of the Darangen epic who possessed magical flying shields and defeated thousands of invaders single-handedly.

hero.name: Rajah Indarapatra
hero.title: Sovereign of Mantapuli
hero.effect: Spear of the Heavens: Attacks any enemy card anywhere on the battlefield with full ATK.
hero.lore: A wise king who possessed a magical flying spear and dispatched divine avian scouts to liberate Mindanao from monstrous titans.

hero.name: Labaw Donggon
hero.title: Demigod of Panay
hero.effect: Divine Belt of Strength: Reduces incoming damage from non-Hero units by 50%.
hero.lore: Son of deity Alunsina who sailed across mystical seas with his magic boat to vanquish the hundred-headed serpent and Lord of Darkness.

hero.name: Handiong
hero.title: Hero of Ibalong
hero.effect: Beast Tamer: Prevents adjacent Mythos cards from attacking for 1 turn.
hero.lore: The legendary culture hero of Bicol who tamed colossal serpents, wild boars, and winged sharks with law and martial steel.

hero.name: Baltog
hero.title: The First Slayer of Tandayag
hero.effect: Primal Grip: Pin down 1 enemy card, rendering it unable to move or act for 2 turns.
hero.lore: First hero of the Ibalon epic who defended early settlements against the monstrous Tandayag boar with bare hands and sheer courage.

hero.name: Ang Panday (Flavio)
hero.title: The Blacksmith of Deliverance
hero.effect: Balisong of Meteoric Fire: Attacks bypass enemy armor DEF completely.
hero.lore: A humble blacksmith who forged a supernatural dagger from a fallen celestial meteorite that transforms into an enchanted sword of justice.

hero.name: Darna
hero.title: Warrior of the White Stone
hero.effect: Cosmic Dive: Rushes across 3 tiles instantly to strike an enemy with +5 bonus damage.
hero.lore: The celestial warrior emissary of the cosmic stone who defends the oppressed against sorcery, alien warlords, and gorgons.

hero.name: Captain Barbell
hero.title: Champion of the Solar Crest
hero.effect: Solar Shockwave: Knocks back the defending enemy unit 1 tile and deals 6 damage.
hero.lore: Empowered by a mystical cosmic barbell, he channels pure solar energy to lift mountains and vanquish supernatural menaces.

hero.name: Pedro Penduko
hero.title: Master of Ancient Agimat
hero.effect: Talisman Swap: Can switch places with any friendly unit on the battlefield once per turn.
hero.lore: Resourceful Filipino folkloric adventurer wielding mutya stones and ancestral charms against engkanto and shadow spirits.

hero.name: Tuwaang
hero.title: Hero of the Kuamanon
hero.effect: Golden Shield Ride: Can fly over occupied tiles without stopping.
hero.lore: Manobo epic champion who rode the wind on magical golden shields and defeated the Lord of the Underworld.

hero.name: Sandayo
hero.title: Prince of the Subanon
hero.effect: Woven Barrier: Protects adjacent allies from taking any damage for 1 full turn.
hero.lore: Subanon epic hero born into celestial light whose handkerchief transformed into an impenetrable dome of protective wind.

hero.name: Maria Makiling
hero.title: Guardian Spirit of the Mountain
hero.effect: Verdant Blessing: Restores 3 HP to all friendly field units at the start of every turn.
hero.lore: The benevolent diwata who watches over the misty mountain slopes, blessing noble wanderers with enchanted golden ginger.
